svg.title: napari-chat-assistant system design
svg.desc: Architecture poster with request routing, local model, tool execution, viewer data, code review, storage, voice, SAM2 and diagnostics.

g.text: Local imaging workbench · live viewer context · deterministic actions · Ollama assistance
Implementation map | v2.3.4 | committed source at 2ed1876 | 10 November 2026
Reply → transcript Tool → dispatcher Code → review panel
Viewer state feeds the next turn; the model does not own the viewer.
Run My Code → execute user Python after preflight
Optional Voice Input → editable prompt text
Compact viewer payload goes to the model.
Layer profiling uses local image information.
Session memory binds follow-ups to prior outcomes.
Pending actions and pending code remain explicit.
Context is refreshed after tools change the viewer.
Matched local routes can avoid Ollama entirely.
Code / repair intent can skip local workflow routing.
Workflow executor assesses and refines mask quality.
Unmatched requests continue to the model path.
Payload: compact context + memory + user request.
Background request keeps model I/O off the UI thread.
Fast mode adjusts reasoning for supported models.
Normalized response: reply, tool, or code.
Model loading / unloading and pull progress are available.
ToolSpec describes parameters, layer types and mode.
Worker tools compute through napari thread_worker.
Returned results are applied through the UI callback.
Direct actions and model-selected tools share dispatch.
NumPy, SciPy, scikit-image and matplotlib support analysis.
Interactive tools: intensity, line profile, group comparison.
Layer outputs stay attached to the live viewer.
Built-ins include inspection and synthetic examples.
Some registered workflow / SAM names are placeholders.
Execution namespace: viewer, selected_layer, np, napari.
exec(compile(...)) runs inside the napari process.
Captured stdout and errors appear in the transcript.
Validation is a preflight check, not a security sandbox.
Capture source information, transforms and layer state.
Generated image data can be stored beside the manifest.
Shapes / points and display properties are serialized.
Restore reopens sources or loads saved layer assets.
This is workspace persistence, not a model memory DB.
Pin, tag, rename and reuse prompts or code.
Action definitions describe direct execution targets.
UI state remembers layouts and selected preferences.
Templates are curated starting points, not RAG retrieval.
Input-device selection + live recording level meter.
Transcription runs in a background worker.
Voice window stays available during viewer work.
Requires optional dependencies and local model assets.
Submitted speech follows the ordinary request routes.
Adapter prepares 2D numeric grayscale input as RGB.
SAM2 produces segmentation masks for viewer results.
Backend setup checks environment and model assets.
3D propagation is exposed through the tool layer.
SAM2 is a separate optional model from the chat LLM.
Local model by default; base URL is configurable.
Model payload contains text context, not image uploads.
Large arrays and synchronous steps can still block UI.
Undo snapshots cover viewer controls, not all operations.
Uncommitted remote-execution work is outside this map.
Read with system-design.md for request examples, source links, implementation boundaries and regeneration instructions.
Architecture documentation only · no runtime code changes · SVG remains editable and sharp at any zoom
